localChanges: Collapse a repeated extglob whose single branch is made of single-character matchers and stars, so +(*a) no longer compiles to a nested unbounded quantifier.
Literalize other single-branch wildcard extglobs that can still backtrack, including bash mode.
Rename the package to @tzudong/picomatch-4 so the unresolved registry advisory is not reintroduced by the picomatch name.
Replace the polynomial bracket scan in removeBackslashes with a linear walk that keeps the same escapes.
